data.source: current rice-merged web sales and dish libraries
data.sales_history_rule: date < target; append only after all meals predicted

development_folds.selection_rule: Chronological expanding-history forecasts; compare mechanisms on early+middle, then audit late and full development stability. All three are development folds, not untouched tests. No rule keyed to specific failed dates.

calendar.boundary_rule: Use explicit calendar flags and adjacent known-calendar nonholiday days; missing dates cannot establish boundaries
calendar.unknown_boundary: null distance, explicit warning; no invented start or boundary inferred from quantities/absence
calendar.special_core: named Spring Festival statutory interval, joint with school holiday

selection.normal_stable_total: exact preserved baseline final session and original-unit totals, rtol1e-12 atol1e-8
selection.fixed_menu_item_only: retain prior minimum hit-MAPE gain0.25pp and all risk gates
selection.total_change_gate_rationale: Prior all-date exact-total gate is inapplicable to requested special-stage demand changes; use targeted round 0.05% relative materiality, ordinary stable dates remain exact
selection.when_total_materially_improves_hit_regre: max(1pp,5% of baseline); apply full and fixed-menu paired comparisons
selection.intervals: Report coverage/width and interval score separately; do not inflate intervals to claim success

allocation.different_units: no exchange; new special-stage total applies proportional old unit shares unless independently validated unit demand model
allocation.upper: historical q99*2; fixed-total item experiments also baseline*2
allocation.conflict: explicit whole-session baseline fallback, never hidden relaxation

repeat.rate: shared normalized names/current high-frequency unique names, all categories
repeat.infeasible: record shortage and fail candidate; no artificial quantity shrink

ablation: volume only, count only, their combination; all item mechanisms paired on fixed baseline menus; add one major mechanism per run and remove components from final candidate

stop.rule: After required distinct directions plus sensible combinations/ablations, stop if three successive materially different directions fail gates; repeated parameter changes do not count

retest.label: 既有区间复测; no subsequent tuning or independent-test claim

deployment: independent candidate archive; never replace web default without user request
